searched: Web searches (October 2026) for OpenAI safety, alignment, preparedness and policy leadership changes 2023–2026 (Brundage, AGI Readiness, Campbell, Kokotajlo, Superalignment, Madry, Quiñonero Candela, Heidecke, Glaese, Jain, Achiam and Mission Alignment, Makanju), Anthropic safety leads and Responsible Scaling Officer changes, Google DeepMind AGI safety leadership (Shah, Legg, Dragan) and xAI safety roles; people's own posts and pages first, then company pages, then reporting. Retrieved and used: Brundage's and Campbell's Substack posts, Kokotajlo's LessWrong profile (the LessWrong GraphQL API returned nothing; the profile page was read), Quiñonero Candela's and Sharma's X posts, OpenAI's Foundation update and Global Affairs newsletter, Anthropic's Safeguards Research Team post and Alignment Science Blog index, Google DeepMind's April 2025 post, the GDM team's August 2024 Alignment Forum post, Shah's homepage, a Singapore Conference on AI page, and reporting by WIRED, CNBC (relay), Business Insider, TechCrunch, Engadget, Ars Technica and Obsolete. Not retrieved: Sam Altman's July 2024 X reply on Madry, Quiñonero Candela and Weng (no post ID could be found; recorded through Engadget), Altman's 25 September 2024 note (X long post truncated by the syndication endpoint; recorded through TechCrunch), The Information and the FT (paywalled), Quiñonero Candela's LinkedIn posts (not admissible; recorded through Obsolete, an independent journalist's newsletter), hendrycks.com (empty shell directly and via relay), Platformer beyond its opening (paywall), Sharma's attached letter (image). Checked but not recorded: Anthropic's RSP page (versions to 3.4, July 2026) names no Responsible Scaling Officer, and no RSO change after Kaplan was found; GDM's July 2026 team update names no leadership; xAI named no safety lead in any source found, only Hendrycks as adviser; Altman's December 2025 post seeking a Head of Preparedness; Engadget's August 2026 report (relaying the FT) that the Preparedness team was disbanded, corrected after OpenAI denied it, and Engadget's understanding that Dylan Scandinaro was no longer head of preparedness (no announcement; left out); the reported departure of OpenAI ethics lead Chloé Bakalar (not researched further); Sharma's homepage, which still says he leads the team after his departure (stale; not used). Left out by scope or sourcing: Allan Dafoe, Dave Orr and Helen King (named in rosters, not recorded separately), Holden Karnofsky's and Andrea Vallone's reported moves to Anthropic (reporting only, no lead role found), Chris Lehane, Madry's later roles (no source found), William Saunders and other non-lead researchers.
